states: 25 states, 1 crisis (most cautious) to 25 boom (most aggressive), as pcp and fmre number them
stored_unit: pcp's Mandate stores the curve as annualised_log_return, ln(1 + p/100); the cockpit converts on save (DECISIONS C-21)
adjust: point i = preset_i + shift_pp + tilt_pp x (i - 13) / 12; the tilt leaves the mean unchanged

presets.name: Gain role
presets.description: The gain role's shape: deep in crisis, strongest in boom. Scaled to half its amplitude around 4 % a year, so the target asks for growth without asking for the full crisis loss.
presets.formula: 4 + 0.5 x (fmre gain profile in % - its mean)

provenance.unit_of_source: annualised_log_return, converted to percent as (exp(v) - 1) x 100

presets.name: Income role
presets.description: The income role's shape: a loss in deep crisis, steady carry through the middle states, highest in boom; around 3 % a year.
presets.formula: 3 + 1 x (fmre income profile in % - its mean)

provenance.unit_of_source: annualised_log_return, converted to percent as (exp(v) - 1) x 100

presets.name: Stabilisation role
presets.description: The stabilisation role's shape: strongest in the contraction states, flat in expansion, around 3 % a year.
presets.formula: 3 + 1 x (fmre stabilisation profile in % - its mean)

provenance.unit_of_source: annualised_log_return, converted to percent as (exp(v) - 1) x 100

presets.name: Protection role
presets.description: The protection role's shape: highest in crisis, lowest in stagnation, rising gently into boom, around 3 % a year.
presets.formula: 3 + 1 x (fmre protection profile in % - its mean)

provenance.unit_of_source: annualised_log_return, converted to percent as (exp(v) - 1) x 100

presets.name: Balanced blend
presets.description: 40 % gain, 20 % each of income, stabilisation and protection: the four role shapes mixed and centred on 3.5 % a year.
presets.formula: 3.5 + (0.4 gain + 0.2 income + 0.2 stabilisation + 0.2 protection, in % - its mean)

provenance.unit_of_source: annualised_log_return, converted to percent as (exp(v) - 1) x 100

presets.name: Growth and income
presets.description: 60 % gain, 40 % income: an equity-led shape softened by carry, centred on 4 % a year at 70 % of its amplitude.
presets.formula: 4 + 0.7 x (0.6 gain + 0.4 income, in % - its mean)

provenance.unit_of_source: annualised_log_return, converted to percent as (exp(v) - 1) x 100

presets.name: U-profile (barbell)
presets.description: Strong in crisis and in boom, weak in the middle: 7 % at both ends, 1 % at state 13.

presets.name: All-weather
presets.description: Gently U-shaped with a low amplitude: 3.8 % at both ends, 2.3 % in the middle.

presets.name: Steady return
presets.description: Flat: the same 3.5 % a year in every state.

presets.name: Crisis-resilient
presets.description: Rising towards crisis: 5.5 % in state 1 falling to 1.5 % in state 25; asks most when markets are worst.

presets.name: Growth tilt
presets.description: Rising towards boom: -2 % in state 1 to 8 % in state 25; accepts a loss in crisis for more in boom.

presets.name: Capital preservation
presets.description: Flat and low, never negative: 1 % a year in every state.

presets.name: Recovery seeker
presets.description: An S-curve: modest in crisis (0 %), steepest through the middle states, levelling at 6 % in boom.

_about: Named target curves for the Parameters page. Data, not computed by the cockpit. Model-derived research output; not investment advice.
